conditions: Applies to the text interpreter and valid numeric conversion as scoped by §3.4.
limitations: The draft supplies a separate ambiguous condition if neither lookup nor conversion succeeds. This finding does not specify optional number syntax or behavior after that condition.

triggers: Evidence correction, scope change, or contrary primary material.

statement: The dated Forth 2012 draft describes text interpretation as looking up a token in the dictionary before attempting numeric conversion. A successful numeric conversion places the number on the data stack in interpretation state, or compiles code to place it there when run in compilation state.
